verdict.rationale: uv documents official CI integration via astral-sh/setup-uv GitHub Action, deterministic caching, lockfiles, non-interactive commands (uv sync, uv run, uv tool run), and self-updating standalone installer, all suited for headless/CI automation. missing for 10: no independent hands-on CI success report, and community notes some Docker friction (uv-comm-16) that slightly tempers a perfect score.
